frequency_question: What proportion of formal institutional recognition review proceedings facing potential revocation result in a definitive final termination order rather than renewal or extension within the designated timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes any formal Department of Education review of a national accrediting body's status where termination or revocation is actively considered and reaches a deadline. Excludes voluntary relinquishments of accreditation authority.

cases.name: ACICS final appeal and second termination order 2022

coverage_note: 6 named comparable review processes; captures major contested federal accreditor reviews over three decades.
known_gaps: Excludes minor advisory committee preliminary letters that did not advance to formal departmental secretarial review.
skeleton: Total recognition review actions involving major accreditors with explicit revocation threats (6) vs actions resulting in definitive final revocation orders (2)
multiplier: 2 hits / 6 total comparable administrative review instances
validity_reason: Administrative procedures governing institutional recognition and Secretary of Education review powers remain stable under current statutory frameworks until legislative overhaul.
